| Peter,

For the last 20 years, Emerge has worked to build a powerful grassroots network of support with the goal of securing representation for the New American Majority by giving women the tools and skills they need to win elections.

**In 2024, 68% of our more than 600 Emerge alums running for office won their race – _bringing a new vision to public office!_ **None of this would have been possible without all of us working together to drive real change in our community.

Friend,
---
The left-wing media is running headlines claiming I’m a “fallen hero.”
---
They say I was once known as “America’s Mayor,” but now I’ve been disbarred, indicted, arrested, and could face 20 YEARS in prison.
---
_But the media is dead wrong!_
---
You see, I didn’t earn the title “America’s Mayor” because the media praised me.
---
I became “America’s Mayor” because I _FOUGHT_ for the American people!
---
For years, I fought the Mafia, I fought injustice, I fought crime, I fought corruption, I fought for President Trump’s rights, I fought for our dignity after the tragedy of 9/11.
---
_And today, God knows that I’m _still_ that fighter._
---
**The only difference is that I am now fighting for my OWN freedom and justice against a ruthless cabal of prosecutors and judges who operate just like the Mafia.**
---
And right now, I’m in the fight of my life – __literally__.
---
**If the Democrat Attorney General in Arizona gets her way, I will spend 20 years in prison. And, Friend, I’m already an 80-year-old man, you can see where this is going... _The Left wants me to take my last breath in a prison cell._**
---
**And because the Democrats have brought charges against me at the __state__ level, President Trump can’t even issue a federal pardon to save me!**
---
When these leftist crooks first had me booked, they filed my mugshot under **booking # 2313757** ...
---
And today, to show them that good and honest Americans like _YOU_ are also fighters who refuse to stand by as they destroy the life of an INNOCENT man all for defending our 45th and 47th President, I’m humbly asking for your support to raise **$231,375.70** for my Legal Defense Trust to WIN the trial of my life and the fight for my freedom and justice.

name: Brittany Pettersen (via VPP)
subject: Voting with my newborn son
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
Absolutely nothing could stand in my way from being in the Capitol to vote against their cruel and dangerous bill.
| Hi friend, Congresswoman Brittany Pettersen here — the Voter Protection Project said I could reach out.

This week, I traveled across the country with my newborn son to vote against the GOP’s outrageous plan to rip away health care from millions of kids, seniors, pregnant women, and so many more — all so they can give tax breaks to their billionaire donors and friends. [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/87370?t=6&akid=19085%2E878179%2EZLo9Mj) Republican Leadership blocked my ability to vote remotely after giving birth to my son, Sam. It’s outrageous that they would force new parents to choose between caring for our newborn and representing our constituents — but absolutely nothing could stand in my way from being in the Capitol to vote against their cruel and dangerous bill.

You better believe that I’ll be there — no matter how challenging it might be — when Republicans are trying to strip away critical programs like Medicaid and SNAP.

**That’s why I voted against the GOP’s plan to rip away health care, take food off of people’s tables, and make life more expensive for hardworking families — all so they can hand out trillions of dollars to billionaires and wealthy corporations.**

Look, I promised that I would fight every day for regular families — and I’ll always be there to hold Republicans accountable when they’re hurting hardworking people.

No matter what is thrown our way, I will do what’s right for the American people — but I could really use some support at this moment, because we know this won’t be the last of their attacks.

[Our team is powered by grassroots supporters like you, friend, and every dollar makes a difference. If you could split a donation between our team and the Voter Protection Project, it would mean so much to me.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/87370?t=7&akid=19085%2E878179%2EZLo9Mj) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Brittany Pettersen and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/87371?t=8&akid=19085%2E878179%2EZLo9Mj)

If you’re not mad yet, you should be. House Republicans made a promise. They said they’d lower our costs and fight for the American people. But last night, they proved, _again,_ that they can’t be trusted. The Republican House passed a budget blueprint that extends **Trump’s $4.5 trillion tax cuts for billionaires** ... and they’re making us _pay for it._ How? **By slashing nearly $900 billion from Medicaid** , putting up to **36 million** Americans at risk of losing their health care. **By cutting $230 billion from food assistance** , potentially taking groceries away from **9 million** low-income households every month. **By gutting clean energy investments and repealing renewable energy tax credits** , making sure energy bills go up for families while fossil fuel CEOs pocket record profits. The GOP’s budget puts more people at risk and takes away the support they rely on — all so the ultra-rich can get another tax break. This fight is bigger than politics. It’s about people. clean_body: Medicaid? Slashed. Food assistance? Cut. Clean energy? Gutted. | If you’re not mad yet, you should be. House Republicans made a promise. They said they’d lower our costs and fight for the American people. But last night, they proved, again, that they can’t be trusted. The Republican House passed a budget blueprint that extends Trump’s $4.5 trillion tax cuts for billionaires ... and they’re making us pay for it. How? By slashing nearly $900 billion from Medicaid , putting up to 36 million Americans at risk of losing their health care. By cutting $230 billion from food assistance , potentially taking groceries away from 9 million low-income households every month. By gutting clean energy investments and repealing renewable energy tax credits , making sure energy bills go up for families while fossil fuel CEOs pocket record profits. The GOP’s budget puts more people at risk and takes away the support they rely on — all so the ultra-rich can get another tax break. This fight is bigger than politics. It’s about people. **Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. # FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism -- mostly the latter -- and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today 's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

---
Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun 's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

| | Peter, Did you hear the big news today in the fight against the Chinese Communist Party?
---
_**"The line against Beijing is drawn in Little Rock...****[Gov. Sarah] Sanders is introducing new legislation that adds further measures to stop China state-owned businesses from operating in her state and shut down programs sponsored by China.****The measures include banning CCP-linked companies from buying or leasing property, blocking ownership near critical****infrastructure****sites, scraping Sister City partnerships and cutting funding for universities and colleges that have Chinese-funded programs."**_ \- Fox News

# Georgia State Election Board Dismisses True the Vote Litigation
---
| Today, the Georgia State Election Board dismissed all pending litigation involving True the Vote, effectively bringing an end to a legal dispute that never should have begun.
---
For the past four years, True the Vote sent data, documents, research, and formal complaints for the State’s review. Yet the only investigation that ever occurred was aimed not at our evidence, but at us. This unprecedented move diverted attention from the core issue: ensuring transparency and accountability in elections.
While True the Vote welcomes the dismissal of this case, the broader implications remain concerning. Actions like these can have a chilling effect on civic engagement and the willingness of citizens to raise legitimate concerns. No organization or individual should face legal action simply for advocating for election integrity.
Despite the challenges, True the Vote remains committed to our mission. We will continue to stand for transparency, accountability, and the right of every citizen to participate in a fair and honest electoral process.
Thank you to everyone who supported us through this odyssey in lawfare. Today, we won.
Ever onward.

| | | Peter, Feeling overwhelmed by the negativity in the news? We’ve put together the February WFP Newsletter just for you, to unpack some of our major work (and wins!) of the last month, as we strive to build the country of our dreams. Let’s get started!
* * *
### _Rep. Lateefah Simon to Deliver Working Families Party Response to Presidential Address_
**We at the Working Families Party are thrilled to announce that Congresswoman Lateefah Simon (CA-12) will deliver our eighth annual response to the President’s address to Congress on March 4th!** [](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIxhQ3A1i_f6xd1i1rk79rtB_K-3eyCR_zu5Jbqd88W1uZxVzdBSm3IiSlUVfx-UGjwmi4Nl0YrcYOBEbrH6yeHsozzJjMp0hzj6K2QErt-5T5Dkm8attmh_B0VuWYpGg3iDFHGdfnai4O4GTp7MifPtpiyF-LEhwzUlrT9n8ixHj1WAFl0gxwBspHbQngtxgvIJMt-66ZU2ZrWxUsAF7ML6pugrME0MexZyQtTBIAMXoYeapkig1PPQl16-BI_ZnMKBGEcinCWoVOdZN0pS3jLpBfTNobFAKtjePnS2t8f4uk/4ed/-8Oz45BiSUGJU-YpXGvWdg/h0/h001.1nldZHZLap-2OzcXx8-cQ-tjMN7RNl381kMiLiSLnxE) “Working people are looking for leaders who will fight for them, and Rep. Lateefah Simon was born to lead in this moment,” said Maurice Mitchell, National Director of the WFP. “As a working mom who has struggled with the crushing weight of medical debt, Rep. Simon understands what Trump’s attacks on Medicare and Medicaid will mean to millions of families in our country. She knows that every family, no matter their circumstances, deserves the best possible health care.” **[To hear Lateefah deliver WFP’s vision for our country, sign up here](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIxhQ3A1i_f6xd1i1rk79rtB_K-3eyCR_zu5Jbqd88W1uZxVzdBSm3IiSlUVfx-UGjwk1Hk1UhcxwPc7H45zTixd9Azih4JvGcZTDKC6sYTrx2WBSCcpLN-2iztUmGrQbALm-6fcXi_-ZczC5dPBcaliAZf1y7ilIR3EbbkFFeuOTn4OIJq3EijEZ3XaNBmlrQhZUw_FwNLbf5f_kJ9dhmHMsif1C3DMRfCv5Bxmt-N0umjr9oTH9f6hLu6j2LJ38tWX3lqxOX0njB64RfJkOROEHFT56Jrc9uCd2XtW8nMPK0/4ed/-8Oz45BiSUGJU-YpXGvWdg/h1/h001._LWu9nYn9qSiuT2FDF8UjvIy1SrBdVBeJqntJ3r9B9w)** or **text SOTU to 30403** for more info on how to tune in!
* * *
### _WFP stands up to the Trump White House_
In the month since Donald Trump has taken office, his administration (and his cronies across the country) have attacked our human rights, our constitution, our jobs, and programs that working families rely on like Medicaid and early childhood education. But we’re fighting back just as hard. And we’re powered by the amazing WFP members who have been dedicating their time, energy, and resources to _blocking_ the far-right and _building_ the working-class movement of our dreams. Here are just a few highlights of how we’ve been standing up to the Trump White House: **FIRE ELON MUSK**
* _Tens of thousands_ of you signed **[our petition to fire Elon Musk](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRImmimh3jp2d-3TZzmeeGfu-UTQdsDuya64KpuO8JCNfpJz62tZbS1uRaEs6xz5o92rDg2XhEAJvsJFbdUoEPfHeyhplR8xlGYyiPdqSrTFjOz2aUIv1O58mTQR6k1Q3SH5v3Llowx_16HXBxc48345cV8UlliT5apJEWY8MtKUqcJjoOBtRQ3-EL_o3bHuxecQ2ykkAwM7bdEGHXTacAJ-t8DJi3eAWwyh7BFg0ob5nk4qoMqSwXygUZ1ohjxvKphRSdPR1wnDwV3tvMBK7tehB2SUuSEl4GkhyBFy68MDyVOKLt7wU9Ivfr-8D0D1UgPjoqafcbQpsE3w-f-b0lZA05BHQYeSMA9-PRTIZH4Ln_mq8zSnCIqm7FGDdKZmdFc/4ed/-8Oz45BiSUGJU-YpXGvWdg/h2/h001.1tjU9cf8qSVFrMyNxwTRt94_JPLAtr9jxHTFLX5D5AI) from the federal government.**
* _Thousands_ of members **texted MUSK to 30403** to call their Senators and demand that they work to push Musk out.
* And we hit maximum capacity at a phone bank to reach out to voters and help them call their Republican representatives and urge them to stop Musk’s cuts to our vital programs like Medicaid and early childhood education. Missed it? **[Sign up to join the WFP Call Team for updates on our work to hold our elected officials accountable and support our endorsed candidates this year.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIxLu_Xi4kTg6U5gTalj1phaR5tri0M3AFXSmAG3t9m4fWs57Kx_NexxpDvJbVgtXH6jvfgQwwdJPwPJ7MphbCiIB0R8j2uP-MxJN3x9GUySVOM-IRnqUevHm38qnWgMOYeebXn7WdWttUUdaRWisFKfruNKUtF15KSCbidYa8qvR85s-OMlNlsAijg9gCUpN19s9COBTaWBh-o9aiy3WyK-SxwpTMXS7dSKDxxs9odLyfLMhVwzU1UshZq23zOdB7R_aINjv8qhhWxIx6txuoY10HRf5dOKLvB9NhHwWsOrTY/4ed/-8Oz45BiSUGJU-YpXGvWdg/h3/h001.KJAW9WXdAaiznM2VqPov6ZClu8KVOJQiir_gejwQCnw)**

**CONGRESSIONAL RECESS**
* During this past week of Congressional Recess, WFP members turned out in force to call on their representatives in NJ-07, NY-17, PA-07, PA-10, and WI-01 to oppose cuts from DOGE, as well as the massive cuts to health care and education and in the proposed House Republican budget. Check out this shot of over 100 constituents gathering in the cold outside Rep. Lawler’s office in NY-17!

**NO SPENDING FREEZE**
* Following Trump’s announcement of a federal spending freeze, we joined allies at Indivisible and MoveOn to host a mass organizing call to help make sense of our political moment and share strategic guidance on how to take action. Over 50,000 people joined us on the call to learn how they can get involved in our movement and stand up to the Trump administration. **[You can watch the full recording of the call here.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMT44nj5rB-PsUn1rqU_riY4fk8JqkfIlc_4aZCG4_Avq5zi43DnW_oyUCfeOMKXdAxNND8qSohnQ4rryRFfJDsmD1aPUteZBRGzXF-7qgrhxJqmUEY8yHiSGRQnSXV4L9vzvcsA2RqoUX6N2GcnN1OR2yViG_fpDIULk6w1fznnTq5DEtSaOCTB2wMn9np3Zx1JGSbKYpkkbpu-GZD1qV9f0EB8VayYCqEEjJmMfAQu8OC2bQOA87H17xjU-i_P61-ioeB7AX-Igf0AFjMHEUgO3D0GTEKmK_fuEJvpBL3U807XSS9dXHSZQk4ECPpzf6hCt6Esq722p5SwqNmumwoQfFPLGeMHHi_IFfFmmwkMSwKOUF5M-IYHZCaT62EFoNAA2mryXp9mFt8IjcoYN_eo4cRO4n1K8uD67WsecWU0hIA0-YAr6vx6WodVgAVOhGO_p6GpKWtkw_HIL12-u1WU/4ed/-8Oz45BiSUGJU-YpXGvWdg/h4/h001.wONltUwYVUP8IJ1C3XoQR0ckGtl6Qx2Lel1IhojXbUE)**

* * *
### _Election Day Victories in Wisconsin and Seattle_
Wisconsin held primary municipal elections last week, and we were proud to endorse three amazing champions: Nikki Conklin for Madison Alder District 9, Yeannette Figueroa Cole for Madison Alder District 10, and Carl Bryan for Kenosha Unified School District Board. Now we’re thrilled to announce that all three are moving on to the April 1 general election! Local elections like these have a major impact on our communities, and are a crucial part of our organizing strategy. We also endorsed an exciting ballot proposition in Seattle to implement social housing with a tax on wealthy businesses, which won its election earlier this month! **_[The Seattle Times](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMTDvrwa2GSzDPCxQj0yU6eDPiH5YrA4nopu6Llo-vLfgqaoHNBhmyusGSGr1Haz4Mt1o-HTp5SwfBNXxb-q3_jUWZBM9xtZqpMeUiwIuspgC60t1bPtoWEt4gSxcH5zDvYOERYSW6uU6Tc_KxWJg_30RJcN1T21Wy-Tpn5HUgZp_p8Vl7mVrCz6IWrY-M4EkwteDl7VPsPBZTBOwMr2KqWGqbHbhqu0LCFhcPjqf8hPQFWfql0vAsR9I6txnD7Pgnulnt1Cboc3Lglc3NM7Q1HkBWMROOSBmlTStlS-PeF-O_6xKlt_yjkw2c-bzK5tguoagK3do7VLDGe-kv8XO7zdNqxqfvCaWWKoo5CeVLJMyFjbhe-O7h9hdq71aOj3xwySAO5M5RZVsLf2L1RQB594SevUVTNzeBC2e7tHCB1OMdgcpiCXJe5k_ZZDT2v06PqiwbIF64scn9qFR54usJhLOEGNA8DtnHpKcWruiYfehEXg7CSe-ePh7z03f5VnjUw/4ed/-8Oz45BiSUGJU-YpXGvWdg/h5/h001.G6sZ1dKntnnbdel5PNOJ70Gf-_kPsVYmuc5OjqoTGYI)_ explains:** “The goal of the developer is to provide mixed-income housing, mostly for working families who fear being priced out of Seattle. It’s a Viennese vision of housing that aims to fill the gap between for-profit builders of higher-end homes and developers of deeply affordable housing for people earning little to no money. Because the housing would be publicly owned, it would be below market rate in perpetuity.” Congratulations to our hardworking teams and allies in Wisconsin and Washington, and especially the voters who turned out to make this a reality!

### _NYWFP Speaks Out Against Mayor Adams’s Corruption_
In September, the New York Working Families Party called for NYC Mayor Eric Adams to resign amidst criminal investigations. This month, we’re renewing those calls because he has shown an inability to make sound policy decisions and is unequivocally willing to trade immigrant New Yorkers for his own personal freedom. The situation is so untenable that some of the most talented leaders in city government — individuals who are impeccable public servants and have led through the toughest circumstances — have announced their decision to step down. This is an all-out crisis and responsibility rests at the very top. Mayor Adams is not able to govern. He must resign.

### _Training the WFP Champions of the Future_
Over the last month, we’ve hosted “Working Folks Win!” — a two-part training series that prepares the passionate members of our movement to run for office or recruit working class candidates in their communities. **A whopping _379 people_ attended these trainings, and we wanted to share some their testimonies:** “Very blessed to join this training. Not really planning to campaign myself politically — will be part of future WFP events though — but the energy here is great!! Thinking this positively good feeling could overflow into other parts of my life!! 🙂” “I’m feeling deeply overwhelmed, but strangely more hopeful at the same time. I’m again impressed by the strategic intelligence of the WFP.” “I like that you guys hit us hard with the facts. I noticed someone in the chat was concerned about getting votes in “deep red areas” and as a person from a deep red area (Arkansas, originally) I understand their concern. That’s why I liked your focus on the idea of message over policy for campaigning. Democratic policies may be more popular, but Democrats aren’t. I liked the practicality of the advice to focus on values and fighting for people. That’s what people want.” “I came in a little late because a meeting I had to attend went over, but as soon as I jumped in everything was making sense. I think that’s really important because it demonstrates how approachable the teachings are. No jargon, just really useful information.” We run trainings throughout the year to help empower our members to become the activists and leaders our communities need. Stay tuned for more opportunities to get involved!

clean_body: | | | Peter, Feeling overwhelmed by the negativity in the news? We’ve put together the February WFP Newsletter just for you, to unpack some of our major work (and wins!) of the last month, as we strive to build the country of our dreams. Let’s get started! Rep. Lateefah Simon to Deliver Working Families Party Response to Presidential Address We at the Working Families Party are thrilled to announce that Congresswoman Lateefah Simon (CA-12) will deliver our eighth annual response to the President’s address to Congress on March 4th! “Working people are looking for leaders who will fight for them, and Rep. Lateefah Simon was born to lead in this moment,” said Maurice Mitchell, National Director of the WFP. “As a working mom who has struggled with the crushing weight of medical debt, Rep. Simon understands what Trump’s attacks on Medicare and Medicaid will mean to millions of families in our country. She knows that every family, no matter their circumstances, deserves the best possible health care.” or text SOTU to 30403 for more info on how to tune in! WFP stands up to the Trump White House In the month since Donald Trump has taken office, his administration (and his cronies across the country) have attacked our human rights, our constitution, our jobs, and programs that working families rely on like Medicaid and early childhood education. But we’re fighting back just as hard. And we’re powered by the amazing WFP members who have been dedicating their time, energy, and resources to blocking the far-right and building the working-class movement of our dreams. Here are just a few highlights of how we’ve been standing up to the Trump White House: FIRE ELON MUSK Tens of thousands of you signed from the federal government. Thousands of members texted MUSK to 30403 to call their Senators and demand that they work to push Musk out. And we hit maximum capacity at a phone bank to reach out to voters and help them call their Republican representatives and urge them to stop Musk’s cuts to our vital programs like Medicaid and early childhood education. Missed it? CONGRESSIONAL RECESS During this past week of Congressional Recess, WFP members turned out in force to call on their representatives in NJ-07, NY-17, PA-07, PA-10, and WI-01 to oppose cuts from DOGE, as well as the massive cuts to health care and education and in the proposed House Republican budget. Check out this shot of over 100 constituents gathering in the cold outside Rep. Lawler’s office in NY-17! NO SPENDING FREEZE Following Trump’s announcement of a federal spending freeze, we joined allies at Indivisible and MoveOn to host a mass organizing call to help make sense of our political moment and share strategic guidance on how to take action. Over 50,000 people joined us on the call to learn how they can get involved in our movement and stand up to the Trump administration. Election Day Victories in Wisconsin and Seattle Wisconsin held primary municipal elections last week, and we were proud to endorse three amazing champions: Nikki Conklin for Madison Alder District 9, Yeannette Figueroa Cole for Madison Alder District 10, and Carl Bryan for Kenosha Unified School District Board. Now we’re thrilled to announce that all three are moving on to the April 1 general election! Local elections like these have a major impact on our communities, and are a crucial part of our organizing strategy. We also endorsed an exciting ballot proposition in Seattle to implement social housing with a tax on wealthy businesses, which won its election earlier this month! explains: “The goal of the developer is to provide mixed-income housing, mostly for working families who fear being priced out of Seattle. It’s a Viennese vision of housing that aims to fill the gap between for-profit builders of higher-end homes and developers of deeply affordable housing for people earning little to no money. Because the housing would be publicly owned, it would be below market rate in perpetuity.” Congratulations to our hardworking teams and allies in Wisconsin and Washington, and especially the voters who turned out to make this a reality! WFP National Director Maurice Mitchell on All In with Chris Hayes WFP leader Maurice Mitchell appeared on MSNBC’s All In with Chris Hayes to talk about the challenges that our country is facing — as well as how important it is that we stand together and take action. Here’s one highlight: “All of those who voted against [Trump], they’re still here. And they are primed, if there’s leadership, to move and to get into motion... Public courage is contagious.” One of the First Big Elections of 2025 is Around the Corner WFP champions Aisha Braveboy is running for County Executive in Prince George’s County Maryland — and her election is this Tuesday, March 4! Aisha has proven herself as a progressive prosecutor who carried out bold reforms to ensure fairness and accountability in the justice system, and her work as Delegate, Chair of the Legislative Black Caucus, and State’s Attorney makes her ready to deliver strong, people-first policies for Prince George’s County. Prince George’s County is Maryland’s largest jurisdiction, and home to a significant portion of the state’s federal workforce. As Trump and Musk relentlessly attack federal workers, it’s urgent that we have strong representatives to fight for them and provide progressive leadership for the state and the nation. Rhode Island Champions Launch their Working Families Agenda Last week, 15 Rhode Island state legislators unveiled a Working Families Agenda to combat the Trump agenda and invest in working people across the state. The thirteen-point plan would protect working families in Rhode Island by guarding against cuts to Medicaid and federal funding, promoting affordable healthcare, preventing retaliatory evictions, and ensuring people making more than $625,000 a year pay their fair share. With these 15 WFP champions making up a full 20% of Rhode Island State Representatives, their vision and leadership is tremendously important, and we couldn’t be more proud. NYWFP Speaks Out Against Mayor Adams’s Corruption In September, the New York Working Families Party called for NYC Mayor Eric Adams to resign amidst criminal investigations. This month, we’re renewing those calls because he has shown an inability to make sound policy decisions and is unequivocally willing to trade immigrant New Yorkers for his own personal freedom. The situation is so untenable that some of the most talented leaders in city government — individuals who are impeccable public servants and have led through the toughest circumstances — have announced their decision to step down. This is an all-out crisis and responsibility rests at the very top. Mayor Adams is not able to govern. He must resign. Training the WFP Champions of the Future Over the last month, we’ve hosted “Working Folks Win!” — a two-part training series that prepares the passionate members of our movement to run for office or recruit working class candidates in their communities. A whopping 379 people attended these trainings, and we wanted to share some their testimonies: “Very blessed to join this training. Not really planning to campaign myself politically — will be part of future WFP events though — but the energy here is great!! Thinking this positively good feeling could overflow into other parts of my life!! 🙂” “I’m feeling deeply overwhelmed, but strangely more hopeful at the same time. I’m again impressed by the strategic intelligence of the WFP.” “I like that you guys hit us hard with the facts. I noticed someone in the chat was concerned about getting votes in “deep red areas” and as a person from a deep red area (Arkansas, originally) I understand their concern. That’s why I liked your focus on the idea of message over policy for campaigning. Democratic policies may be more popular, but Democrats aren’t. I liked the practicality of the advice to focus on values and fighting for people. That’s what people want.” “I came in a little late because a meeting I had to attend went over, but as soon as I jumped in everything was making sense. I think that’s really important because it demonstrates how approachable the teachings are. No jargon, just really useful information.” We run trainings throughout the year to help empower our members to become the activists and leaders our communities need. Stay tuned for more opportunities to get involved! Member Spotlight everyone, I'm Destiny Arturet! I'm a documentary filmmaker and video producer with a background in nonprofit media and grassroots organizing. I'm a huge fan of Murder, She Wrote, puppets, Boston Terriers, and Maine. Over the last eight years, I've come to realize that our two-party system is failing the most vulnerable and the hardest-working people in the United States. I kept my eye on the Working Families Party over the years and learned that WFP is a party that recognizes that change takes time, it takes the community, and it takes a lot of grassroots effort and building. It's scrappy, it's strategic, it's welcoming, and it wants to hear from real people. It wasn’t my intention to join a Wolf Pack — a small, action-oriented group of leaders who take on specific roles to grow WFP membership and amplify our national activist work. I just didn't see a lot of people stepping up. I knew that if I could partner with other leaders who had their pulse on what was happening in my state, I could lean on my strengths as a good communicator, a good organizer, and a good cheerleader. I really love seeing how excited folks are to get involved. We're still getting started so I think there's so much more to witness and experience but I'm grateful that my co-leaders are so thoughtful and engaged. I'm happy to work with them! Upcoming Events The official Working Families Party response to President Trump's address to the joint session of Congress will be delivered by Rep. Lateefah Simon (CA-12) on Tuesday, March 4th, 2025. Join us to hear the WFP’s vision for a country that works for the many, not the few! or text SOTU to 30403 to sign up. Join us for a mass call at 8 PM tomorrow, Thursday, February 27! Our Making Meaning of the Moment calls bring together leaders across this movement to unpack our current political moment and share our strategy to build a government for the many, not the few. There are going to be a lot of important fights ahead of us this year — and one of the most effective ways we can make an impact is by having conversations directly with voters. By joining the WFP Call Team, you’ll stay in the loop on opportunities to hold our representatives accountable and support WFP-endorsed candidates at phone banks throughout the year. body:
Absolutely nothing could stand in my way from being in the Capitol to vote against their cruel and dangerous bill. |
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102848862/530476711/-1739289520?refcode=WUEFH259_20250226_PettersenSplit_ALL&sourceid=1055756&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTEwMzE3Ny1hNmY0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pJ0bitm4r9l4K7lYrya4BywpRuyXPNnyEz9GcnCS3co=) Hi Peter, Congresswoman Brittany Pettersen here — EMILYs List said I could reach out.

This week, I traveled across the country with my newborn son to vote against the GOP's outrageous plan to rip away health care from millions of kids, seniors, pregnant women, and so many more — all so they can give tax breaks to their billionaire donors and friends. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102848864/530476712/-2081426563?refcode=WUEFH259_20250226_PettersenSplit_ALL&sourceid=1055756&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTEwMzE3Ny1hNmY0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pJ0bitm4r9l4K7lYrya4BywpRuyXPNnyEz9GcnCS3co=) Republican Leadership blocked my ability to vote remotely after giving birth to my son, Sam. It's outrageous that they would force new parents to choose between caring for our newborn and representing our constituents — but absolutely nothing could stand in my way from being in the Capitol to vote against their cruel and dangerous bill.

You better believe that I'll be there — no matter how challenging it might be — when Republicans are trying to strip away critical programs like Medicaid and SNAP.

**That's why I voted against the GOP's plan to rip away health care, take food off of people's tables, and make life more expensive for hardworking families — all so they can hand out trillions of dollars to billionaires and wealthy corporations.**

Peter, I promised that I would fight every day for regular families — and I'll always be there to hold Republicans accountable when they're hurting hardworking people.

body:
Absolutely nothing could stand in my way from being in the Capitol to vote against their cruel and dangerous bill.

| Hi, Congresswoman Brittany Pettersen here — Fight for Progress said I could reach out.

This week, I traveled across the country with my newborn son to vote against the GOP’s outrageous plan to rip away health care from millions of kids, seniors, pregnant women, and so many more — all so they can give tax breaks to their billionaire donors and friends.
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102849251/530480280/-2031176685?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2025-02-26_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkyMmI5Yzg1LWE3ZjQtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9s--S9GMES-o0AFwGSD9NN6CGj2bPJ-3gpau45N8l8w=)
Republican Leadership blocked my ability to vote remotely after giving birth to my son, Sam. It’s outrageous that they would force new parents to choose between caring for our newborn and representing our constituents — but absolutely nothing could stand in my way from being in the Capitol to vote against their cruel and dangerous bill.

You better believe that I’ll be there — no matter how challenging it might be — when Republicans are trying to strip away critical programs like Medicaid and SNAP.

**That’s why I voted against the GOP’s plan to rip away health care, take food off of people’s tables, and make life more expensive for hardworking families — all so they can hand out trillions of dollars to billionaires and wealthy corporations.**

I promised that I would fight every day for regular families — and I’ll always be there to hold Republicans accountable when they’re hurting hardworking people.

No matter what is thrown our way, I will do what’s right for the American people — but I could really use some support at this moment because we know this won’t be the last of their attacks.

---|---
|
#### **New Petition 25AKEI - Alaska Election Integrity**
---
**This act addresses several aspects of voting and election procedures, including:**
1. **Voter ID and residence requirements.**
2. **Voter registration, including the inclusion of registration forms with permanent fund dividend applications.**
3. **Election administration and ballot counting.**
4. **Absentee, early, and mail voting.**
5. **The publication of election pamphlets.**
6. **Protection of confidential information in voter registration records.**

---
[**Click Here to Help Finance the Film Project**](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67bffcc3032c1a14eedb8ab8&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tropictundra.com%2Ffrozen-odds&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_67bffbd3457a5f4a1f05c805&l=en-US&s=cyTrrgj6V4LOCCk-CkJIoHJeTXo%3D)
---
**I had planned to pay for the filming, production, and marketing for my new movie. But I wanted to open it up for people to help finance the film. Your contribution will help finance the film and you will be invited to private early screenings and opening. You will get a Frozen Odds physical and digital copy of the movie, you will also get a custom shirt and coffee cup. Finally, Your name will be featured in the credits of the movie. "Frozen Odds" we will start filming this spring / summer and I plan to bring some great people from around the country to Alaska and do interviews with Alaskans about their experience with Lisa Murkowski, Ranked Choice Voting, and the hard push by out of state interests to take over Alaska.****This project will be filmed with Netflix approved Red Digital Cameras, used on popular movies like Guardians of the Galaxy, Matrix, Skyfall, Wednesday and thousands more.**
---
[_ _ Click Here to Join Frozen Odds Film Project _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67bffcc3032c1a14eedb8ab8&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tropictundra.com%2Ffrozen-odds&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_67bffbd3457a5f4a1f05c805&l=en-US&s=cyTrrgj6V4LOCCk-CkJIoHJeTXo%3D)
---
#### **ANNOUNCEMENT: Captain Seth Keshel and Dr. Chris Mattmann Join Frozen Odds Movie as Featured Experts**
**We’re honored to announce that Seth Keshel, MBA, will be featured in Frozen Odds, the powerful documentary on Alaska’s citizen-led fight against Ranked Choice Voting (RCV).****Seth Keshel is a former Army Captain of Military Intelligence and Afghanistan veteran. His analytical method of election forecasting and analytics is known worldwide, and he has been commended by President Donald J. Trump for his work in the field. He most recently made headlines by correctly forecasting a 312-226 Trump victory in the Electoral College, with accurate picks in all 56 races for electoral votes.****Captain Keshel proposes 10 Points to True Election Integrity and has identified Ranked Choice Voting as one of the eight cardinal sins of election administration. He toured Alaska in the spring of 2022 while fighting the information battle associated with promoting election integrity.****In Frozen Odds, Captain Keshel will bring his expert analysis and firsthand experience to expose the flaws of RCV and its impact on election integrity.****Dr. Chris Mattmann Joins Frozen Odds as Featured Expert****We’re thrilled to announce that Dr. Chris Mattmann, a leading AI and data expert, will be featured in Frozen Odds, a powerful documentary on Alaska’s citizen-led fight against Ranked Choice Voting (RCV).****Dr. Mattmann’s career is nothing short of extraordinary. He is the Chief Data and AI Officer at UCLA, former Chief Technology and Innovation Officer at NASA JPL, and President of Mattmann.ai. An accomplished author and industry leader, he has played key roles in advancing AI, big data, and technology across multiple fields.****With firsthand experience in RCV from his time at the Apache Software Foundation, Dr. Mattmann will break down its flaws in Frozen Odds, sharing his expert insights and concerns based on real-world applications.****Stay tuned—Frozen Odds is coming soon to reveal the truth behind Alaska’s fight for fair elections.**
---
---
|
---
**Starting a film project for Amazon Prime, YouTube, etc. – Frozen Odds How do you take on $15 million with nothing but determination, grassroots organizing, and a clipboard? Frozen Odds is a gripping documentary that uncovers the raw power of citizen-led initiatives in Alaska. Following the journey of a small but determined movement, this film reveals how everyday people—outspent 100 to 1 by out-of-state interests—rallied together to challenge the system. Led by an Alaskans for Alaskans who helped write the law and push it to the ballot, this battle wasn’t just about policy—it was about democracy in its purest form. With 400+ volunteers braving the cold, gathering 42,000 signatures when only 26,000 were needed, they proved that people—not money—should shape the laws that govern them. Through intimate interviews, on-the-ground footage, and stunning Alaskan landscapes, Frozen Odds captures the high-stakes struggle against political elites (aka Lisa Murkowski and George Soros, etc.) and the enduring spirit of grassroots activism. Though the campaign fell just 700 votes short out of 320,000, it laid the groundwork for a new wave of initiatives—this time, with three fresh petitions ready to take the fight forward. In a world where billionaires and lobbyists try to control the political process, Frozen Odds asks a bold question: What happens when ordinary citizens refuse to back down?**
---
|
---
**I have three more petitions coming soon.****My competition spends millions to do a project that costs me 0.1% what they spend. Of course I’m going to continue.****1\. Election Integrity****2\. Voter ID / US Citizenship requirements****2\. Ban foreign funding of ballot initiatives****3\. Remove voting machines for State and Federal elections in Alaska**
---

subject: Moving into March with meaning / Entrando en marzo con significado
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
📱 KEEP UP THE CALLS 📱
Tell your Texas lawmakers to oppose extremist legislation
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Texas%20Capitol%20Austin%20building.jpg]
Texas Republicans in our state legislature are known for moving with lightning speed to shove through bad bills that attack our freedoms, and this legislative session is turning out to be no different. GOP state senators in the Senate Committee on Criminal Justice have passed pieces of legislation earlier this month — SB9, SB40, SJR1, and SJR5 — that further chip away at our fundamental rights and our access to justice. We still have time to combat these bad bills in the Texas House, but we need your help NOW.
Make calls with us this week! Let’s make clear that ALL who call our state home deserve to have their full rights respected.
LIKE and SHARE this Facebook graphic to contact your state representative and spread the word! [https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=1565972334174608]
For more information on how to get involved in TOP's efforts to combat these bad legislative proposals and more, email Laquita at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
MARCH 19:
Dallas County TOP housing justice campaign meet-up
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dallas%20housing%20justice%202024.jpg]
TOP's Dallas County Housing Justice campaign is gearing up to have a bigger impact this year to protect the rights of local tenants.
Join us at our next campaign meeting on March 19 from 5 - 7 p.m. at the Dallas TOP office (3910 Gaston Ave., Ste. 250) where we'll break bread and plan out our campaign organizing efforts for the coming months.
Come drop by and find out how you can be part of our work! For more information, contact Iman at ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] .
Make the shift and give us a follow
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bluesky.png]
¡TOP ahora está en Bluesky!
En vista de lo tóxico que se ha vuelto el discurso público en la cuenta X (Twitter) del presidente Musk en las últimas semanas, el equipo de comunicaciones de TOP está priorizando el desarrollo de nuestra presencia en Bluesky.
¡SÍGUENOS en @txorgproject.bsky.social! [https://bsky.app/profile/txorgproject.bsky.social]
TOP Tip: Stop the spread. Detect and root out online disinformation.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Social%20media%20fake%20news.jpg]
In recent years, apps and platforms have become a haven for bots, fake profiles, fake news articles, and now deceptive AI-generated videos. We have to protect our mental bandwidth, especially in this weird Trump/Musk era. Check out these tips from the Southern Poverty Law Center on how you can prevent yourself and others from falling for harmful online disinformation. [https://www.splcenter.org/resources/hope-watch/spotting-ai-disinformation-tips/]
Español
📱 SIGAN CON LAS LLAMADAS 📱
Díganle a sus legisladores de Texas que se opongan a la legislación extremista
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Texas%20Capitol%20Austin%20building.jpg]
Los republicanos de Texas en nuestra legislatura estatal son conocidos por moverse a la velocidad del rayo para impulsar proyectos de ley malos que atacan nuestras libertades, y esta sesión legislativa no está siendo diferente. Los senadores estatales republicanos en el Comité Senatorial de Justicia Penal han aprobado proyectos de ley a principios de este mes (SB9, SB40, SJR1 y SJR5) que socavan aún más nuestros derechos fundamentales y nuestro acceso a la justicia. Todavía tenemos tiempo para combatir estos proyectos de ley malos en la Cámara de Representantes de Texas, pero necesitamos su ayuda AHORA.
¡Haga llamadas con nosotros esta semana! Dejemos en claro que TODOS los que consideran nuestro estado su hogar merecen que se respeten sus derechos completos.
¡DALE UN LIKE y COMPARTE este gráfico de Facebook para contactar a tu representante estatal y difundir la información! [https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=1565972334174608]
Para obtener más información sobre cómo participar en los esfuerzos de TOP para combatir estas malas propuestas legislativas y más, envíe un correo electrónico a Laquita a lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
19 DE MARZO:
Reunión de la campaña TOP por la justicia de vivienda del condado de Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dallas%20housing%20justice%202024.jpg]
La campaña de TOP por la Justicia en la Vivienda en el Condado de Dallas se está preparando para tener un mayor impacto este año para proteger los derechos de los inquilinos locales.
Únase a nosotros en nuestra próxima reunión de campaña el 19 de marzo de 5 a 7 p. m. en la oficina de TOP en Dallas (3910 Gaston Ave., Ste. 250) donde compartiremos ideas y planificaremos nuestros esfuerzos de organización de campaña para los próximos meses.
¡Ven y descubre cómo puedes ser parte de nuestro trabajo! Para obtener más información, comunícate con Iman en ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] .
Haz el cambio y siguenos
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bluesky.png]
¡TOP ahora está en Bluesky!
En vista de lo tóxico que se ha vuelto el discurso público en la cuenta X (Twitter) del presidente Musk en las últimas semanas, el equipo de comunicaciones de TOP está priorizando el desarrollo de nuestra presencia en Bluesky.
¡SÍGUENOS en @txorgproject.bsky.social! [https://bsky.app/profile/txorgproject.bsky.social]
Consejos de TOP: Detener la propagación. Detectar y erradicar la desinformación en línea.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Social%20media%20fake%20news.jpg]
En los últimos años, las aplicaciones y plataformas se han convertido en un refugio para bots, perfiles falsos, artículos de noticias falsos y, ahora, videos engañosos generados por inteligencia artificial. Tenemos que proteger nuestro ancho de banda mental, especialmente en esta extraña era de Trump y Musk. Echa un vistazo a estos consejos del Southern Poverty Law Center sobre cómo puedes evitar que tú y los demás caigan en la desinformación dañina en línea. name: Senator Joni Ernst
subject: Cutting the pork and trimming the fat
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
Do you support DOGE?

Friend,

The waste in Washington has gone on for far too long, and it's time to _**[rip it out by the roots.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfjk5i48sd78u5lpjjvohj68r2no697b9dtn0vb8_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdim2o31c1h2bs)**_

In the Senate, I'm leading the charge with the **[Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE)](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3hq0c2f1bg26aitl8t0datettro9rddvrui4kh0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdim2o31c1h2bs)** to cut through the red tape and slash the bloated spending that's been draining YOUR taxpayer dollars.

**[I'm not just talking about trimming the fat here -- we're going straight for the jugular with a full-scale overhaul of how your hard-earned money is spent.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zaunsheredojjqcpvalp7ei96n6iinlpvmva5ns8_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdim2o31c1h2bs)**

But here's the reality -- according to some estimates, **[35% of Americans will NEVER support DOGE.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zb5iv10vo2asb377bgqeo35gnoo3rgig7i8i0sig_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdim2o31c1h2bs)**

But I know you will never be a part of that 35%. _**[Am I right, friend?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zar3ksqikdrrbd31p7i9e4qgb8fd6mibtc5jvvm0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdim2o31c1h2bs)**_

**[Do you support DOGE?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjjmp98kq9miiadh4boq3h54q5qs2t5fblss7a70_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdim2o31c1h2bs)**

******************************************************[YES](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z967in44t140bb5cq3jnmsvbdp841iglkf0jap1g_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdim2o31c1h2bs)****************************************************** ******************************************************[NO](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0qu15ggdrg9i4p8jptecd2ic408sfgocunt62h8_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdim2o31c1h2bs)******************************************************

The choice is yours, friend.

Americans are counting on us to make DOGE a success, and I need you by our side.

Thank you,

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3ohb1uksi3gvl600kitfsm1r574o3o9c1rg4000_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdim2o36cdh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Friend of Liberty,

Did you know that America's Founders rejected birthright citizenship--the idea that someone who is born within our country's borders is automatically a citizen?

This idea--which is a misunderstanding of the meaning of citizenship--is the subject of an ongoing national debate that will have long-lasting implications for our nation.

I'm writing today to offer you a FREE issue of _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale College's digest of liberty, that explains the facts about birthright citizenship.

**In this FREE issue, "Birthright Citizenship and Dual Citizenship: Harbingers of Administrative Tyranny," you'll learn:**

* Why the Founders rejected automatic citizenship based on birthplace
* How the 14th Amendment has been misinterpreted over the years
* What reforms are needed to restore the true meaning of citizenship

Since you're a concerned citizen and an intelligent patriot, I know you'll find this issue interesting and informative. It will help equip you to engage in this critical debate.

And, if your friends and family have questions about this topic, you may want to share this _Imprimis_ issue with them.

name: Hillsdale College via Updates For Great Americans
subject: The pharmaceutical industry
body:
In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zcfgdhasc9es4hehbir0cpmllqo0gos11en5oamg_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdim2p76chh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You'll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/big-pharma-cca/](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z3qjup49i210gss7tia0t8d70lohr6lfrpjhio2o_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdim2p76chh2bs)**

We filmed the series at a recent Center for Constructive Alternatives conference on the Hillsdale campus. You will not have to watch for long to discover why it was one of our most popular and well-attended events.

**Please use the secure link above to receive your Big Pharma video series. When you complete the form, we will email you the series so you can watch it immediately.**

Warm regards,

Dear Friend of Liberty,

Did you know that America's Founders rejected birthright citizenship--the idea that someone who is born within our country's borders is automatically a citizen?

This idea--which is a misunderstanding of the meaning of citizenship--is the subject of an ongoing national debate that will have long-lasting implications for our nation.

I'm writing today to offer you a FREE issue of _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale College's digest of liberty, that explains the facts about birthright citizenship.

* How the 14th Amendment has been misinterpreted over the years
* What reforms are needed to restore the true meaning of citizenship

Since you're a concerned citizen and an intelligent patriot, I know you'll find this issue interesting and informative. It will help equip you to engage in this critical debate.

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: Misunderstanding American citizenship
body:
Why the Founders rejected automatic citizenship based on birthplace

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z5voic366ait4npg6l2l5dbuudluq6k56j9lsrk8_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdimeor6cdh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Friend of Liberty,

Did you know that America's Founders rejected birthright citizenship--the idea that someone who is born within our country's borders is automatically a citizen?

This idea--which is a misunderstanding of the meaning of citizenship--is the subject of an ongoing national debate that will have long-lasting implications for our nation.

I'm writing today to offer you a FREE issue of _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale College's digest of liberty, that explains the facts about birthright citizenship.

**In this FREE issue, "Birthright Citizenship and Dual Citizenship: Harbingers of Administrative Tyranny," you'll learn:**

* Why the Founders rejected automatic citizenship based on birthplace
* How the 14th Amendment has been misinterpreted over the years
* What reforms are needed to restore the true meaning of citizenship

Since you're a concerned citizen and an intelligent patriot, I know you'll find this issue interesting and informative. It will help equip you to engage in this critical debate.

And, if your friends and family have questions about this topic, you may want to share this _Imprimis_ issue with them.

You can receive your FREE copy of **" Birthright Citizenship and Dual Citizenship: Harbingers of Administrative Tyranny"** at this secure link:

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/birthright-citizenship-imprimis](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zqf0u3r0h26jmfm9oq7vt8ra5vphd164tgbmvnn8_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdimeor6cdh2bs)

Please don't delay! Get your free copy right away.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

On Tuesday, February 25, 2025, 184 USA volunteers in 11 states presented USA’s audit of their state’s official data as evidence of severe problems in our election systems. All were well received by over 200 state representatives or staff members, with productive meetings and potential for future action. This important citizen advocacy effort is part of USA’s ongoing strategy to secure our election systems nationwide. Volunteers were asking for investigations into the election misconduct uncovered by USA’s forensic investigations, as well as requesting their representatives sponsor legislation to guarantee real votes, real voters, real counts and real proof in the 2026 midterm and all future elections. Volunteers will be following up with their representatives to present legislation USA is drafting to require transparency, authenticity and system-wide accuracy with real time audits, monitoring, and compliance. Stay tuned for more details and updates.

name: Josh W.
subject: I’m the teacher who’ll bring GOP to its knees in 2025
body:
| | | | | | [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wlgw7-v9ilvo-kyd76rh6/)
---
# **I’m the teacher who’ll bring GOP to its knees in 2025**
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wlgw7-v9ilvp-kyd76rh7/)
---
| | | | friend, If you and I haven't met yet, my name is **Josh Weil**. I'm a single father, Democrat, and public school teacher running in the Special Election for Florida's 6th Congressional District -**_the bellwether first election of 2025._** As we begin to hit our stride after a whirlwind first few weeks of this campaign, I haven’t yet had the chance to sit down and write out the story of who I am & why I’m running so let me tell you about why you should put your belief into this scrappy campaign that _stands to topple the GOPs razor thin 1-vote majority._ My career has been **_defined_** by work with at-risk or post risk populations in public schools. I worked for three years in juvenile detention under the FL Department of Juvenile Justice, then for two years at University Behavioral Center, a residential mental health hospital for teens. In these programs, kids were typically _5 years behind grade level_ and the programs were _extremely_ underfunded and under-resourced. As a result I had to wear a bunch of different hats - teacher, therapist, parent, and more. **It’s a helluva a job (literally),** and it’s not for everybody, but I am proud to have made a tangible impact with these students and this experience was _foundational_ in making me the teacher that I am today. I now work in Florida’s Osceola County public schools where I am on the leadership team of Kissimmee Middle School - a title one school (schools which have a high population of low income families and in turn receive lots of extra supplemental funding, all students receive supplemental funding). On the leadership team of Kissimmee: I’m an instructional coach for teachers, the Dean of Students where I handle behavior issues with students and families, and the MTSS coordinator - a role required under education law where I monitor/track student data across the school and then coordinate interventions and individualized education plans (IEPs) for students who are underperforming. In my first year where I oversaw Math, scores went down in every category at my school **_except_ math** which went up one point. In my 2nd year, I oversaw all of STEM where we made major gains in both categories and became the __**_highest gaining_** __ **_school_** __ in the whole county/district for that category. I have devoted my life’s work to **solving challenges that seem insurmountable to most** , to uplifting students and classrooms that society and our GOP state legislature have written off. So when I read that a special election would be held in my community for a vacant House seat following a Trump cabinet appointment, I saw an opportunity to tackle a challenge that I am uniquely qualified to take on and conquer. Before our launch, we were warned by Doubting Thomases that the Democratic base was burnt out, defeated, and apathetic in the aftermath of Kamala Harris’s defeat. We were told that we would be hard pressed to find people who would donate and or volunteer on this race. _They told us to give up._ My belief then and ever more so now is that when the chips are down and we’re backed into a corner is when we fight the hardest—and**now I am vindicated _every day_ as Democrats from across the US pour in to _fight with us_**. [**_Together we can rob the GOP of their 1-vote majority and restore hope to a movement reeling from our 2024 defeat - can you make a donation today to help us rapidly scale this campaign in time for our April 1st election?_**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wlgw7-v9ilvq-kyd76rh8/)
---
| [Chip in $10](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wlgw7-v9ilvr-kyd76rh9/)
---
| [$26 for 2026](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wlgw7-v9ilvs-kyd76rh0/)
---
| [Chip in $100](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wlgw7-v9ilvt-kyd76rh1/)
---
| [RUSH $250](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wlgw7-v9ilvu-kyd76rh2/)
---
Thank you for being a part of this movement to stop Project 2025 and send a teacher—not a book banner—to Congress. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, and we _cannot_ afford to miss it.
---
|
---
Yours in the fight, Josh Weil Democrat for Florida’s 6th

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=98d2a656451f471382985ee477fdd79f&_e=7nLCfQO7kC69dvy9OpcdL2cAvGqJULC8p26MFDbzDn4GocRDF0SzroD0FBONqSJW8YtDdNsEZ5QjVkbLY7PAPuMAjyDKJslfxz1f0qYjyuKbTy_kZZEf2gFRVpXPlpC3mihmJ6eMciIhknNQPLgGf5_Z8Ey7IadbJ2v-zyTeuDEVfGMZaL9lmowcSOFgBdeOfqibo-GD4A68akEuZ_whoiN939F2P-Pw4YYyRgy6Wl8wkY2nAWkVdSjJOkPXl1TlLWsNNefYCosYbydHRS6EYqL9bcIEXjR3Oa-Gma2gWzzX2IimqIob_D8lf-bXQR9gO2nHeuPSfujLilU6jObSbkzBKrXbjnD3HnzPacVNPM_4oiRlRX6_yYzy6ruhVNqB)

| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You'll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/big-pharma-cca/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=98d2a656451f471382985ee477fdd79f&_e=7nLCfQO7kC69dvy9OpcdL2cAvGqJULC8p26MFDbzDn4GocRDF0SzroD0FBONqSJW8YtDdNsEZ5QjVkbLY7PAPuMAjyDKJslfxz1f0qYjyuKbTy_kZZEf2gFRVpXPlpC3mihmJ6eMciIhknNQPLgGf5_Z8Ey7IadbJ2v-zyTeuDEVfGMZaL9lmowcSOFgBdeOfqibo-GD4A68akEuZ_whoiN939F2P-Pw4YYyRgy6Wl-Qiz_fY17F2_JTORsKQNJvkl0xpJsMT_MPpQcXykOu8Kp1iSuIBYmVHKdcVx5rix-bCK-kJ841RwCp-s9CVZiJvTafqEGRWg9eZlSiM5gC41Eaph6dIobJLhObTXfmwxrUIPRS-G3-181J9Qil-6Kx)**

We filmed the series at a recent Center for Constructive Alternatives conference on the Hillsdale campus. You will not have to watch for long to discover why it was one of our most popular and well-attended events.

**Please use the secure link above to receive your Big Pharma video series. When you complete the form, we will email you the series so you can watch it immediately.**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

It will determine whether you have more in your pocket for the basic necessities of life. It will determine whether American workers will see inflation-adjusted wages rise. And it will determine whether America can compete on the world stage. And right now, America’s economic future is on the line. The Left wants to undo the pro-growth, pro-freedom policies that made America strong—including the Trump Tax Cuts that ignited our economy, created millions of jobs, and put more money back in your pocket. If they get their way, we’ll be stuck with 22% higher taxes,weaker job growth, and a federal government that controls more and more of our economy. For the typical family, this could mean a $1,695 tax increase—taking more money out of household budgets and rolling back the economic progress we’ve made. | | The Club for Growth is fighting to protect the Trump Tax Cuts and restore sound economic policies that will grow prosperity—not crush it under layers of bureaucracy and reckless spending. ## Planetary Parade Lines Up in Night Sky
A rare celestial event will take place tonight and Friday as [seven planets](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGPozAQRn8NdIPMMOBL4eKadLn2SjSxxzAbYyJsBeXfr7L9tp8-PT29_7f5xpo0L_94E1fjPqPBEQwC2jmwpvdMbXBRBGVoxfWWzDSOF6R2dUzY93-CGTkwkZ_YI0Uy3ktPox2mVt2HZhBt3-OFTBfs3Vo7hEnG-xApNmQkaN2P7mvXXFeJ6b2_5Oj8vrXJrbU-SzP8bfDa4PU8z654leyFkxz1c2rwynDwIcBJl7xJrrBHsPBMnKUW0AKVH5qXz-IFNENdBcrjDXXVAqfIoz1ceJ6akpbJNmSWjTX9KNTfkrwcfgcAAP__TN5k-g)—Saturn, Mercury, Neptune, Venus, Uranus, Jupiter, and Mars—become visible in the night sky, creating a striking display of planetary alignment. The event, known as a "[planetary parade,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z71uwyAUxfGngS3W5ZoPZ2Do4i1dO1oYLjEVNpGNgtynr9y925GO9JP-X4_p4VJO2_PTrWRrLBMCqhvgDc0UXMrnJHmwkQip52SFkaCVuqPkix08KD04uCtNYR5wEAgCYnDK6-i04cleGiAaIfAuoQtmNsb0QZOa-ygjk0Ah1bJ33yVtdaGYz_KmvfNl5dkutb4O1n8wHBmOrbVunv31MRw3agfD0e01-UzX9OoM8keoXcnCdxteLeWcDm2YhOfqUv5T63-Vb4u_AQAA__8D81Lv)" can be best seen just after sunset today and Friday. This will be the last opportunity to view all seven planets together until 2040. To see the planetary lineup, start with Venus, Jupiter, and Mars ([see photo](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuhDAQBb8GOiOzGFYULtJcd2lTogWvwZHBlu07xN9HRGlTz9PTaL6e05Ocd8f6STvrYsMEEnohQQBOhpy_JlUbbZmBu5p1i0oOfT-Cqje9QDvMhMoyIxKOaNlIpMGOvIzK9rXT95sEwLaFUcnG4IyInRm4nzurbKUkG1dCar6DO8rG1l_hzalZwl57vZUSc9V9VPCo4HGeZ5MjLXzTCh6USwpxCyWsieLGSSwUyytxFokSi-jp4ELpEuTdeux8FJH5zccfycLynF734NaskzbxdN67PGCl5LqT878i5b8wbw0_AQAA__8IiGkT)), the brightest planets visible to the naked eye. Mercury and Saturn need a clear horizon. Uranus may be spotted with binoculars under dark skies, and Neptune requires a telescope.

* Why the Founders rejected automatic citizenship based on birthplace
* How the 14th Amendment has been misinterpreted over the years
* What reforms are needed to restore the true meaning of citizenship

Since you're a concerned citizen and an intelligent patriot, I know you'll find this issue interesting and informative. It will help equip you to engage in this critical debate.

subject: First Measles Death, Drilling for Water, and Prisoners in Pink
body:
An unvaccinated school-aged child has died from measles in Lubbock, marking the first death in an outbreak that has grown to 124 confirmed cases across nine West Texas counties. According to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), it’s the first measles-related death in the country since 2015.

name: David Horowitz
subject: Who is the enemy within?
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2aq7jv7t2s6hi6nfv2mohcapnvrkldshmv1poq8_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdjmaor6c5h2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zh9qm5geimdqqm754d99lsdgq1trevevli73scrg_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdjmaor6c5h2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,
---

David Horowitz

body:
John Wilkes Booth will forever be infamous for assassinating the man widely regarded as the greatest president in American history, but not all Lincoln-Booth relations were strained.

# [John Wilkes Booth’s brother saved the life of Abraham Lincoln’s son.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sscc9c&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Famous Figures](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sscc9c&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sscc9c&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| J ohn Wilkes Booth will forever be infamous for assassinating the man widely regarded as the greatest president in American history, but not all Lincoln-Booth relations were strained. A year or two before Honest Abe’s death, in fact, Edwin Booth — the older brother of John and a prominent actor — [saved the life of Lincoln’s son](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sscc9c&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) Robert Todd Lincoln, who was then in his early 20s. (The precise date is unknown, but the event is believed to have taken place in either 1863 or 1864.)
---
The younger Lincoln found himself on a crowded train platform in Jersey City, New Jersey, and was accidentally pushed off the platform as a train departed. “In this situation the train began to move, and by the motion I was twisted off my feet, and had dropped somewhat, with feet downward, into the open space, and was personally helpless,” Robert Todd Lincoln later [wrote](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sscc9c&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) of the event that put him in the path of the oncoming train. It was then that Booth grabbed him by the coat collar, saving him. Booth was well known enough as an actor for Lincoln to recognize his rescuer and even thank him by name. In April 1865, the day after his brother assassinated Lincoln, Edwin vowed never to return to the stage — a short-lived promise, as he gave an acclaimed performance in the title role of _Hamlet_ the following year.

## John Wilkes Booth originally planned to kidnap Lincoln.
“All plots tend to move deathward,” wrote Don DeLillo in the 1985 novel _White Noise_ , and so it was with Booth and Lincoln. Booth, a disgruntled actor and fierce Confederate sympathizer, originally had a less violent plan — to [kidnap the president](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sscc9c&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), hold him in Richmond, Virginia (the capital of the Confederacy), and exchange him for a number of Confederate prisoners. He came close to carrying out this plan on March 17, 1865, before Lincoln’s schedule changed at the last minute and he did not attend the play where the kidnapping was to take place. “My love (as things stand to-day) is for the South alone,” Booth [wrote](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sscc9c&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) to his brother-in-law in 1864. “Nor do I deem it a dishonor in attempting to make for her a prisoner of this man to whom she owes so much misery.” The plot was forever scuttled when the Confederacy surrendered less than a month later on April 9. Just five days later, Booth executed the more extreme version of his plan.

| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z10diq59tshptu52c411fd8u2sf8p7osfhfetl50_rp22sh2s8i6eob0cdjm6pb4c1h2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008.
